description: This file contains unit tests for the MyTimesheetAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes setup routines, data providers, and test methods to verify API functionalities such as create, getAll, and update for the timesheet feature.

classes.name: MyTimesheetAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the MyTimesheetAPI endpoints, ensuring proper functionality for create, getAll, update, and handling of unimplemented methods.

methods.description: Initializes the test environment and clears specific database tables before each test.
